headline: NBP zablokował kasę dla TK. Będzie ruch rządu
summary: Finance Minister Andrzej Domański said work is under way to restore payments from Constitutional Tribunal accounts, which the National Bank of Poland blocked. He urged President Karol Nawrocki to sign quickly the changes to personal income tax.
why: The National Bank of Poland is the country's central bank and manages the state's payment flows. Disputes over public finances affect investor views of Polish fiscal governance.
